title: Cumin eggs with spinach
summary: Cumin eggs with spinach is a middle eastern dinner built around medium eggs and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Cumin eggs with spinach. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add medium eggs and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and baby spinach.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Cumin eggs with spinach before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Cumin eggs with spinach.  Serve with the pittas, simmered in salted water until tender.
